name: Buy before build
rationale: Bought products cost less to keep than ours.

name: Data is a shared asset
rationale: One source of truth saves reconciling.

name: Design for failure
rationale: Every dependency will be down some day.

name: Prefer standard interfaces
rationale: Standards make parts easy to swap.

name: Automate by default
rationale: Manual steps are where errors creep in.

name: Reuse before new
rationale: A second copy is a second thing to maintain.

name: Customer first
rationale: Choices are judged by what customers see.

name: Cloud where it fits
rationale: Run it where it costs least to run.

name: Small changes, often
rationale: Small releases are easy to undo.
